approval.reason: Bootstrap r1 baseline for Galaxy Fold8 en-US. Candidate v2 validation passed with runtime-equivalent provenance. The HEAD differs from the execution commit only by previously approved baseline repository updates. No runtime, traversal, validation, or execution-engine code changed after the Full Run. Water Leak and Motion remain accepted false positives caused by the known TTS observation limitation. Home Monitor remains an accepted environment-scoped known accessibility limitation. Clothing Care diagnostics remain acknowledged as non-blocking automation-engine diagnostics.

automation_acknowledgments.comment: Known traversal termination/recovery diagnostic on the Clothing Care screen. Preserved in the approval audit and accepted as a non-blocking automation-engine diagnostic.
